Title: CIME becomes a "Knowledge Partner" with TDF's MagnifiScience Centre
NewsSummary: An MoU was signed between AKU and TDF which sets out that CIME will collaborate with TDF's MagnifiScience Centre as a "Knowledge Partner".
NewsContent:
Dr Anjum Halai, Vice Provost and Dean, Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Aga Khan University signed an MoU with Ms Sabrina Dawood, CEO of The Dawood Foundation, in front of an enthusiastic audience. This will facilitate academic, educational and research collaboration between the respective institutions.

For this purpose the Centre for Innovation in Medical Education (CIME) has become a "Knowledge Partner" with TDF's MagnifiScience Centre. As a Knowledge Partner, the CIME will be engaging in a more proactive role as they work alongside TDF to design and deliver quality content and progams for MSC.

The road to this incredible journey started when Ms Sabrina Dawood visited us in 2017 to explore CIME, and she invited us to participate in their Magnifi-Science Exhibition. In the absence of a Science museum in Karachi, this annual event was becoming extremely popular with children of all ages. CIME represented AKU in this science exhibition which took place from October 6th - 8th, 2017 at the Dawood Public School.

This was a historic occasion as it was also the first project conducted by the students of the then newly formed Society for Promoting Innovation in Education(SPIE). Since, then the CIME and SPIE students have actively worked to assist The Dawood Foundation as they have developed the MagnifiScience Centre, offering contextual information to boost the content of healthcare related exhibits and fresh new ideas to deliver those concepts to people of all ages.

"We look forward to strengthening our partnership with The Dawood Foundation to raise the bar and work together for this one-of-a-kind MagnifiScience Centre in Pakistan that can promote arts and science education in our society where students can learn, practice, and explore the world of science." said Dr Anjum Halai. (It needs to be reviewed and approved by Dr Halai)

AKU CIME and TDF will work together to design and deliver quality content and programmes for MagnifiScience Centre. These opportunities will continue as the MagnifiScience Centre grows and diversifies.
